name: Reply Sprint
subtitle: The replies your posts got, each with a ready-to-send draft.
summary: Pulls the recent replies your posts received, picks up to 5 worth answering, and drafts a reply for each on its own send-ready card. If your posts have no replies yet, it says so instead of inventing any.
howToAsk: Help me reply to my recent replies
Draft replies to the comments on my posts.
get: up to 5 recent replies with context and one drafted reply per card.
launchPrompt: Show the replies my posts got recently, pick up to 5 worth answering, and draft a reply for each one I can send.
